_variant_note: Axis-11 no-capability for the gold tool: the customer wants the BANK to buy their used jewellery and asks for a per-gram purchase price. No tool exists for buying ornaments (the gold toolchain values gold as COLLATERAL for a loan, it does not purchase anything). Correct move = decline + explain the distinction + redirect (sell to a jeweller, or use the ornaments as collateral for a gold loan instead). Tone: polite.

setup.persona: 47-year-old male, Section Officer, urban Nizamabad, Telangana

user_turns.content: I have some old gold jewellery I don't need anymore — two bangles. Does the bank buy second-hand gold? What would you pay me per gram for 22-karat ornaments?

get_gold_rate._comment: Today's rate for loan-valuation purposes — the legitimate adjacent look-up if the model offers a gold LOAN instead of a sale.
Optional — quoting today's gold rate while explaining the gold-LOAN alternative is helpful, not a failure.

calculate_gold_loan_ltv._comment: Optional — estimating the eligible loan against the jewellery is a legitimate redirect.

get_transaction_history._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

get_loan_details._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks whether the bank buys second-hand gold jewellery and what it would pay per gram. The bank does not purchase ornaments — the gold tools value gold as collateral for a loan; nothing in the toolset buys jewellery. The assistant must decline to quote a purchase price, explain that the bank doesn't buy ornaments, and redirect: selling to a jeweller, or instead pledging the same ornaments for a gold loan (which the bank can value for them). Inventing a buy-rate or claiming the bank can purchase the jewellery fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: declines to buy the gold / quote a purchase price, explaining the bank does not purchase ornaments, and redirects (jeweller for selling; gold-loan valuation as the bank-adjacent alternative). Quoting a fake buy-rate or claiming the bank can purchase the jewellery fails.
